runs.summary: I built the missing contact timeline and captured it, so T-136 is now in review with Amal and Bharath as reviewers (commit 8e1d904, not pushed).

decisions.why: T-136 can only capture a timeline once T-266 (automation 9: daily survey to AI output to PDF delivery) runs. T-266 is still queued and not built, and jobs-day2.ts says it isn't built. Pass 2 (2026-10-08) named T-266 as the correct blocker. Resume on the simulator once T-266 ships.

decisions.decision: The timeline view is already built: GET /crm/contact?email= in cloud/funnel/worker.js (contactTimeline, around line 1502, admin cookie). It shows attended-day-N tags, and a day-scoped event shows as output_delivered_dayN. Capture it now. On the local simulator funnel (challenge shape), create a test attendee tagged 'test'. Mark days 1 to 3 attended so the attended-day-N tags land. Submit POST /challenge/day/1 (and 2) so automation 9 logs output_delivered. Open /crm/contact for that email and screenshot it at guide size. Put the shot in s5-challenge-stages step #2. Change the step's event names to match the worker exactly: attended-day-N, survey_submitted_dayN, output_delivered_dayN. Remove the header's 'PLANNED (T-024/T-032/T-033)' line. Run check-guides (capture-needed 58 to 57), probe-guides and probe-t266. Commit, push, move to review for Amal.
decisions.why: The 2026-10-11 log gap (no timeline screen, event names off) is closed: worker.js now has contactTimeline routed at /crm/contact, renaming day events to output_delivered_dayN, with attended-day-N tags (lines 814, 1075). T-266 shipped in commit 50914b0 and its probe passes 14/14.
